summary: Urbanex Realty full-stack review: 25/25 backend pytest tests PASS, all UI flows verified via Playwright. Public content, 12 seeded properties, 19 zones, live YouTube (12 videos from @urbanexbyayandey), public lead capture, admin gating (401 without token, 200 with Bearer/cookie), lead status update + notes, CSV export, semantic search fallback, reports overview, invoice creation (URBX-YYYY-NNNN), and /auth/me all work. Frontend home hero, marquee, testimonials (heading 'Trusted by buyers, sellers and Burdwan-returning NRIs.'), video showcase, properties grid with blurred prices + login-modal gate, zone filter (radix combobox), property detail, About 'Since 2022', Contact form submit + toast, Construction 5-stage timeline + estimate form, Terms/Privacy, floating WhatsApp, admin CRM (leads table, recharts on reports, invoice creation showing URBX-2026-0002) — all verified working. Admin gate correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes /admin/leads/transcribe which imports emergentintegrations.llm.openai.whisper inside handler. If the module path is wrong the function silently returns '[Transcription unavailable: ...]' — verify path once real audio testing is required (skipped per request).

/api/auth/me returns 401 while logged-out; frontend polls it on every public page and logs console errors. Consider suppressing the console error at the fetch layer (treat 401 as normal 'unauthenticated' state) to keep DevTools clean.
server.py `@app.on_event('startup')` and `@app.on_event('shutdown')` are deprecated in FastAPI (use lifespan). Not a bug, but tech-debt.
server.py `ensure_seed()` only runs if properties<12 and doesn't reseed if seed content changes. Fine for MVP; document behavior.
Admin routes at /admin correctly gate on user.is_admin; verify similar gating on any future admin sub-actions to avoid regressions.
test_credentials: Bearer/cookie session_token=adm_test_token_123 for user ayan@urbanex.com (is_admin=true). Seeded in db.user_sessions (expires 2026-07-22). Reseed script in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_-prefixed leads and 2 TEST_ invoices (URBX-2026-0001, URBX-2026-0002) in Mongo. No cleanup performed — safe to leave as they don't affect production seeds; admin can filter with 'TEST_' prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend fully green. Whisper transcription (/api/admin/leads/{id}/transcribe) was intentionally skipped — needs real audio + mic permission. YouTube live-fetch works and returns 12 videos; if quota is hit, endpoint falls back to 3 hardcoded videos automatically. Radix Select filters use role='combobox'; click the trigger and then click role='option' — not native select. Property card has nested <a href='/properties/{id}'> (image area); clicking the 'See price' button opens the auth modal instead of navigating.
